init.title: Spool Bridge options
init.description:
Filament name rules shorten the names of filaments imported from the Spoolman database (e.g. for labels). One rule per line: `pattern => replacement`, or just `pattern` to delete what it matches. Patterns are Python regular expressions; spaces are collapsed afterwards. Leave empty to keep names as imported.

Example:
`™|®`
`\s*\(Formerly[^)]*\)`
